newsitem.title: Turkmenistan: Turkmenistan's 9-month trade deficit at $315.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Turkmenistan's 9-month trade deficit at $315.2 mln.

text.p: Turkmenistan posted a trade deficit of $315.2 million for the first nine months of this year, the State Statistics Committee said on Wednesday.
TURKMEN MERCHANDISE TRADE Jan-Sep 96 Jan-Aug 96 Jan-Sep 95
Notes -- Figures in million dollars, FOB.
Data for January-September 1995 show percentage change of January-September 1996 over January-September 1995.

The figures do not include trade with the Commonwealth of Independent States. But if CIS countries are included, Turkmenistan posted a trade surplus of $358 million for the first nine months of this year.
